description: Unit test class for the Meetings module, testing various functionalities such as object instantiation, ACL, notification, and relationship handling in SuiteCRM.

classes.name: MeetingTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for testing the Meetings module functionalities within SuiteCRM.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes test environment, setting default config and creating a new user bean.

methods.name: testMeeting
methods.description: Tests the instantiation and property values of a newly created Meeting bean.

methods.name: testACLAccess
methods.description: Verifies ACL permissions for a Meeting bean, both with and without a recurring source.

methods.name: testhasIntegratedMeeting
methods.description: Checks the return value of the hasIntegratedMeeting() method.

methods.name: testSaveAndMarkdeletedAndSetAcceptStatus
methods.description: Tests saving, deleting, and setting accept status on a Meeting bean.

methods.name: testget_summary_text
methods.description: Verifies the get_summary_text method returns null when name is not set, and the name when it is.

methods.name: testfill_in_additional_detail_fields
methods.description: Checks population of additional detail fields and related attributes.

methods.name: testget_list_view_data
methods.description: Validates the data structure returned by get_list_view_data.

methods.name: testset_notification_body
methods.description: Ensures notification email body template variables are correctly populated.

methods.name: testcreate_notification_email
methods.description: Verifies creation of notification email objects.

methods.name: testsend_assignment_notifications
methods.description: Tests sending of assignment notifications without errors.

methods.name: testget_meeting_users
methods.description: Checks that get_meeting_users returns an array.

methods.name: testget_invite_meetings
methods.description: Verifies that get_invite_meetings returns an array for a user.

methods.name: testget_notification_recipients
methods.description: Checks that get_notification_recipients returns an array, with or without special_notification.

methods.name: testbean_implements
methods.description: Tests the bean_implements method for various interface strings.

methods.name: testlistviewACLHelper
methods.description: Verifies ACL helper array for list view.

methods.name: testsave_relationship_changes
methods.description: Ensures save_relationship_changes executes without exceptions.

methods.name: testafterImportSave
methods.description: Tests post-import save behavior with different parent types.

methods.name: testgetDefaultStatus
methods.description: Verifies the default status value for a new Meeting.

methods.name: testgetMeetingsExternalApiDropDown
methods.description: Checks the output of getMeetingsExternalApiDropDown().

methods.name: testgetMeetingTypeOptions
methods.description: Validates that getMeetingTypeOptions returns an array.
